answer: Lantern-beacon heartbeat bond: each agent ties a vine line to a river gauge, staking 70 credits. Each epoch the lantern beacon flashes a random challenge; the agent must file a flow heartbeat in time. An auditor rechecks it on the river table within 3%; a late or copied heartbeat burns the bond. The k-th heartbeat costs 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 and lock 70,000 for 40,000. A rented-gauge ring fails; an honest agent pays 35 once.
